from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanySalaryRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's 应付职工薪酬 from their financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as written in the document")
    employee_benefits_payable: str | None = Field(description="应付职工薪酬 amount as written (e.g., '12,049,950.88 元')")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="Amount as a numeric value for categorization")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Report period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    salary_records: list[CompanySalaryRecord]
